svg.text: Full-Size Humanoid Robot: Training-to-Deployment Closed Loop
A clean separation of simulation training, policy handoff, external-PC control, and physical hardware
mass · delay · friction · contact · encoder bias
feedback freshness · tilt limit · timeout · fallback
q* = default pose + scale x action
parallel ankle / waist mapping · joint safety
Motor position / velocity / torque + IMU orientation / angular velocity
Logical joint reconstruction feeds the next observation while ROS2 publishes joint states, status, and errors.
A separate evidence loop keeps experimental analysis out of the real-time control path.
